title: Chris Bledsoe's message from the lady
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Chris Bledsoe's message from the lady, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> This is the message. She told me that she had many names throughout history and that God is God and we don't know what we think we know and we need to sit back and reanalyze and, you know, be good children and we're going off the cliff.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs and other beings appear to him, says a figure he calls "the lady" gave him a message. He says she told him she has had many names throughout history, that God is God, that we do not know what we think we know, and that humanity needs to stop, rethink, be good children, because we are going off a cliff. If true, it would be a warning to humanity from a non-human presence.
